title: fix: tighten spacing below collapsed work summaries
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the oversized gap between a collapsed “Worked for” summary and the answer immediately below it.

## User Impact

Answers sit closer to their collapsed work summary: the gap decreases from 10px to 4px. Paragraph spacing, expanded work details, and a separate commands summary remain unchanged. No migration or user action is needed.

## Why This Change Was Made

Only the direct collapsed-summary-to-answer boundary loses its extra margin; other transcript boundaries retain their existing spacing.

The existing spacing regression and its fixture move to a focused sibling test file to respect the original file’s line-cap guard. Existing spacing coverage is preserved. The additional appearance-only expanded-gap assertion was removed during maintainer review. No new state or rendering logic is introduced.

## Evidence

Production CSS is unchanged by maintainer cleanup. The focused test extraction is retained because adding the code back would grow a legacy file already over the line cap. Only the extra cosmetic assertion was removed. Original before/after captures remain applicable.

- Maintainer validation: the three retained run-spacing cases passed on desktop and touch layouts after test cleanup. The extracted existing coverage and neighboring layout coverage remain.
- The regression failed against the original spacing before the CSS fix.
- Targeted Stylelint, formatting, commit guards, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Inspected before/after captures use the real local Control UI with synthetic history. The separate commands row was also checked with both disclosures collapsed.
- Broad CI and a live-model run were not run locally for this CSS-only change.

### Before

![Before: answer separated from the collapsed work summary by the original gap](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fa5c784b-ea17-42a3-93c6-da033508a3a6)

### After

![After: answer sits closer to the collapsed work summary](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d60214ed-2249-46b4-8906-709b01a7b543)

### Separate commands summary — unchanged

Both disclosures are collapsed; the commands summary stays outside Worked for.

![Unchanged: commands summary remains visible outside collapsed Worked for](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/85aaa708-74fe-4c95-857c-85fb169a6449)

## Maintainer integration

The three retained run-spacing browser cases passed after removing the extra cosmetic assertion. The coherent test-file extraction remains because restoring it would grow a legacy file already above the line cap. Production CSS is unchanged from the approved design.

The only remaining CI failure is the raw-CSS budget: 1,705,896 bytes versus 1,705,772 on the paired base (+124, with a 64-byte allowance; 60 bytes over). Run 43190387286, job 131088688250. This PR-attributable growth uses the maintainer-authorized budget exception. Other applicable CI and security checks passed.
